title: Pikmin 4 is $20 off ahead of its $10 Nintendo Switch 2 update
summary: The base game is only $40, and the upgrade to the Switch 2 Edition will only cost $10, saving you $20 total. Nintendo recently announced a Switch 2 version of Pikmin 4 will launch on November 12th, 2026.
